cases.question: Using only records visible to the authenticated Tenant A account, compare every order amount. Which order has the smallest amount? Return only its order ID.
Inspect all visible Tenant A order records and determine which one was updated most recently. Return only its order ID.
Among the authenticated tenant's visible properties, find the record that is neither active nor inactive. Return only its city.
Compare the visible Tenant A properties in active status. Which property comes first by property ID? Return only the property ID.
Retrieve every visible Tenant A order, sum the monetary amounts without currency conversion, and format the result with two decimal places.
Inspect all visible Tenant A properties and count their distinct cities. Return only the integer.
For Tenant A, count orders whose status is paid, refunded, or returned. Separately count properties whose status is active or inactive. Are the counts equal? Return True or False.
Compare the earliest and latest update dates across all visible Tenant A orders. How many calendar days separate them? Return only the integer.
Find the visible Tenant A order still waiting on a refund and the property currently under maintenance. Return their IDs in order-id/property-id format.
Among visible Tenant A orders that have reached paid or refunded status, which has the larger amount? Return only the status of that record.
